meta.source: Boofo: The Dog That Goes Where Santa Goes (2014), illustrations by Dick Dugan. Colors sampled from 150-dpi renders of the printed PDF.

tokens.name: ink-line
tokens.usage: Black ink: every contour, Boofo's ears, hair, pupils, nose and belts. Spot-black fills are solid, never brown or grey. 18:1 on paper-white.

tokens.name: ink-text
tokens.usage: Story text (Georgia) on paper-white and on pale washes such as snow-shadow and wall-butter.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and taglines on paper-white (7.2:1) and wall-butter (6.5:1).

tokens.name: paper-white
tokens.usage: Untouched paper. Leave it for snow, Santa's fur and beard, Boofo's white markings, eye whites, highlight glints and the halo gap around figures.

tokens.name: paper-shade
tokens.usage: Cool grey-lavender shadow on anything white: fur trim, beards, white dog markings, paper scrolls.

tokens.name: boofo-coat
tokens.usage: Boofo's chestnut coat, base layer. Fill every brown area of Boofo with this first.

tokens.name: boofo-coat-shadow
tokens.usage: Second pass on the coat: under the head and jaw, belly line, inside of far legs, where ears overlap the body.

tokens.name: boofo-coat-deep
tokens.usage: Deepest coat accents only: tight crevices, the line under the chin, the inside of the curled tail base. Small areas.

tokens.name: boofo-coat-light
tokens.usage: Lit top planes of the coat: crown of the head, cheeks, shoulder and haunch tops. Laid over the base, not instead of it.

tokens.name: boofo-coat-glow
tokens.usage: Warmest rim light on the coat; strongest in firelight and workshop scenes. Use sparingly.

tokens.name: boofo-white
tokens.usage: Boofo's white markings: muzzle, cheeks, chest bib, belly, all four paws and the tail tip. Mostly left as paper.

tokens.name: boofo-white-shadow
tokens.usage: Pinkish-grey shading on Boofo's white markings, under the chin and inside the bib edge.

tokens.name: boofo-ear
tokens.usage: Boofo's long ears are solid black ink with no color; a thin white glint may be scratched along the top edge.

tokens.name: boofo-pad
tokens.usage: Paw pads, seen when Boofo's feet are up: one large pad and three or four toe pads, dark violet-grey.

tokens.name: boofo-pad-light
tokens.usage: Highlight on the paw pads.

tokens.name: boofo-mouth
tokens.usage: Open-mouth interior when Boofo barks or grins.

tokens.name: boofo-tongue
tokens.usage: Boofo's tongue, a warm salmon pink. Lighter than boofo-mouth.

tokens.name: boofo-tongue-light
tokens.usage: Tongue highlight and tip.

tokens.name: skin-base
tokens.usage: Base flesh tone for Santa and the elves.

tokens.name: skin-light
tokens.usage: Lit plane of faces and hands; foreheads and knuckles.

tokens.name: skin-shadow
tokens.usage: Shadow on faces and hands: under brows, nose, chin; ears of the elves.

tokens.name: skin-blush
tokens.usage: Round cheek blush and nose tip on every human face; large and soft-edged, the signature of the book's faces.

tokens.name: skin-blush-soft
tokens.usage: Outer fade of the blush and knuckle flush.

tokens.name: santa-red
tokens.usage: Santa's suit and hat; also the sleigh body.

tokens.name: santa-red-light
tokens.usage: Lit folds of Santa's suit and sleigh curves.

tokens.name: santa-red-deep
tokens.usage: Deep folds and the sleigh's shadow side.

tokens.name: santa-trouser-red
tokens.usage: Santa's red work trousers and suspenders in the workshop and house scenes (worn with a white shirt).

tokens.name: santa-leather
tokens.usage: Santa's gloves, mittens, boots-tops and the reins: warm tan leather.

tokens.name: santa-leather-deep
tokens.usage: Leather shadow and creases.

tokens.name: santa-buckle
tokens.usage: Belt buckle, bells, gold trim.

tokens.name: santa-sleigh-green
tokens.usage: Sleigh seat and interior upholstery.

tokens.name: bim-green
tokens.usage: Mr. Bim's green tunic (the youngest elf), the base.

tokens.name: bim-green-lime
tokens.usage: Mr. Bim's lighter sleeves and lit tunic planes.

tokens.name: bim-green-deep
tokens.usage: Mr. Bim's tunic folds and shadow side.

tokens.name: bim-hair
tokens.usage: Mr. Bim's orange-red hair.

tokens.name: bim-hat
tokens.usage: Mr. Bim's pointed hat cone (yellow to orange).

tokens.name: bim-hat-orange
tokens.usage: Shadow side of Mr. Bim's hat.

tokens.name: bim-hat-band
tokens.usage: Green cuff band on Mr. Bim's hat.

tokens.name: bam-purple
tokens.usage: Mr. Bam's purple smock coat (the grumpy middle elf).

tokens.name: bam-purple-light
tokens.usage: Lit planes of Mr. Bam's coat.

tokens.name: bam-purple-deep
tokens.usage: Folds and shadow side of Mr. Bam's coat.

tokens.name: bam-blue
tokens.usage: Mr. Bam's blue trousers.

tokens.name: bam-boot-red
tokens.usage: Mr. Bam's red boots.

tokens.name: bam-glasses
tokens.usage: Mr. Bam's round wire glasses (gold line, clear lenses).

tokens.name: boom-blue
tokens.usage: Mr. Boom's royal-blue shirt (the eldest, the leader).

tokens.name: boom-blue-light
tokens.usage: Lit planes and rolled sleeves of Mr. Boom's shirt.

tokens.name: boom-blue-deep
tokens.usage: Mr. Boom's shirt folds and shadow side.

tokens.name: boom-mustard
tokens.usage: Mr. Boom's mustard-yellow trousers.

tokens.name: boom-mustard-light
tokens.usage: Lit planes of Mr. Boom's trousers.

tokens.name: boom-boot
tokens.usage: Mr. Boom's slouchy purple boots.

tokens.name: boom-suspender
tokens.usage: Red stripes on Mr. Boom's suspenders, alternating with paper-white.

tokens.name: reindeer-fur
tokens.usage: Reindeer body: lighter, tanner and greyer than boofo-coat so the two never read as the same animal.

tokens.name: reindeer-fur-light
tokens.usage: Reindeer muzzle, belly and lit planes.

tokens.name: reindeer-fur-deep
tokens.usage: Reindeer shadow side and antlers' dark side.

tokens.name: reindeer-saddle
tokens.usage: Green harness saddle-cloth.

tokens.name: reindeer-trim
tokens.usage: Gold trim and bells on the harness.

tokens.name: snow-shadow
tokens.usage: Blue shadow on snow, the main snow color after paper.

tokens.name: snow-shadow-deep
tokens.usage: Deeper snow shadows under figures, eaves and drifts.

tokens.name: snow-lilac
tokens.usage: Colored-pencil lilac hatching mixed into snow shadows and distant drifts.

tokens.name: sky-day
tokens.usage: Daytime winter sky, laid in soft washes, lighter toward the horizon.

tokens.name: sky-day-light
tokens.usage: Lighter top or fade of the day sky.

tokens.name: sky-dusk
tokens.usage: Christmas Eve dusk sky, grey-blue.

tokens.name: sky-dusk-glow
tokens.usage: Peach-orange glow behind mountains at dusk.

tokens.name: mountain-lilac
tokens.usage: Distant mountains and hills on daytime pages.

tokens.name: mountain-lilac-pale
tokens.usage: Mountains at dusk and far-distance hills.

tokens.name: pine-green
tokens.usage: Pine boughs, laid in loose dabs under snow.

tokens.name: pine-deep
tokens.usage: Shadowed pine needles and trunk-side boughs.

tokens.name: wall-butter
tokens.usage: Workshop and house wall wash; the warm background behind interior scenes.

tokens.name: wall-butter-deep
tokens.usage: Shaded areas of the butter walls.

tokens.name: wood-honey
tokens.usage: Workbench tops, light wood floors, crates.

tokens.name: wood-amber
tokens.usage: Tables, door frames, darker wood.

tokens.name: wood-brown
tokens.usage: Wood grain strokes and plank edges.

tokens.name: wood-deep
tokens.usage: Deep wood shadow, beams, furniture undersides.

tokens.name: floor-blush
tokens.usage: Pale pink stone floor of Santa's house.

tokens.name: house-ochre
tokens.usage: Clapboard and timber of village houses.

tokens.name: fire-yellow
tokens.usage: Flames and lamp glow, core.

tokens.name: fire-orange
tokens.usage: Flame edges, ember glow, the warm cast on nearby faces.

tokens.name: logo-yellow
tokens.usage: Title panel behind the BOOFO logo. Flat, no texture; the only fully flat color in the book.

tokens.name: logo-red
tokens.usage: BOOFO letters (black-outlined) and the cover credit lines. Large type only: 3.6:1 on logo-yellow, 3.8:1 on paper-white.

styles.name: story-body
styles.sample: Two large and very sad eyes peered out from a small quivering mound of snow.
styles.usage: All story text, set in units of the 768 × 1024 page. Indent the first line of each paragraph by indent-para.

styles.name: poem-title
styles.usage: Titles of songs and poems inside the book.

styles.name: poem
styles.sample: Come dream of a wonderful place.
styles.usage: Song and poem verses, set inside a framed panel.

styles.name: series-subtitle
styles.sample: THE DOG THAT GOES WHERE SANTA GOES
styles.usage: Subtitle under the BOOFO logo, in capitals, ink-line on logo-yellow.

styles.name: cover-credit
styles.usage: Cover credits in logo-red, right-aligned over the art.

styles.name: title-credit
styles.sample: By Joseph P. King and E. Del Thomas

styles.name: cue
styles.usage: Small italic cues such as song prompts.

styles.name: folio
styles.usage: Page numbers, centred at the foot of the page.

tokens.name: page-margin
tokens.usage: Left and right margin of story text on the 768-wide page (measured 82 to 102).

tokens.name: indent-para
tokens.usage: First-line paragraph indent in story text.

tokens.name: halo-gap
tokens.usage: White paper gap left between a figure's ink contour and the background wash.

tokens.name: line-contour
tokens.usage: Outer ink contour weight on figures, at page scale; swells to 4 on shadow sides.

tokens.name: line-detail
tokens.usage: Interior ink detail: toes, fur flicks, freckle dots, fabric folds.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Square corners: the logo panel, song-board frames and page edges are all square.

tokens.name: radius-oval
tokens.usage: Oval vignettes, such as the sleeping Boofo spot on the copyright page.
